purpose: Stable machine-readable field contract for the InterSol Watch Tower object registry. It mirrors the canonical workbook schema without promoting unresolved geometry or implementation readiness.
authority_order: owner-current sketches/instructions and attributable current FreeCAD geometry
current Type 1 Romer Cognigrex qualification/control rows
historical 2022-2023 InterSol owner records for lineage/function only
locked artistic render for aesthetic language only

fields.name: Object_ID
fields.description: Stable Watch Tower object identifier, for example WT-T or WT-L1.

fields.name: Object_Class
fields.description: Assembly, primary structure, node, cable anchor, pole, glazing, roof, MEP, biological, digital or other bounded class.

fields.name: Side_or_Zone
fields.description: Centre, left, right, tower face, roof, whole asset or other explicit zone.

fields.name: Geometry_Authority
fields.description: Source class controlling geometry for this object.

fields.name: Geometry_Status
fields.description: Resolved, current-form/dimensions-open, XYZ-open, unresolved, legacy-placeholder or equivalent explicit state.

fields.name: Nominal_Dimension_or_Rule
fields.description: Only attributable dimensions or design rules; unknown values must remain explicit unknowns.

fields.name: Material_Route
fields.description: Material-family routing or unresolved material status; not an engineering member schedule.

fields.name: Evidence_State
fields.description: OWNER-CURRENT, HISTORICAL, DERIVED_REQUIRED, AESTHETIC_LOCK, R&D or other controlled evidence state.

fields.name: Repo_Key
fields.description: Stable dot-path key for adapters and downstream twins.

fields.name: Digital_Twin_State
fields.description: Gated digital state such as ACTIVE/G1, HOLD-ENDPOINT, G2-HOLD or SCHEMA-READY.

topology_invariants: Central vertical asset identifier is WT-T (Tower T).
There are exactly two primary tower cable-node elevations in the current owner topology: WT-A and WT-C.
WT-A carries four face anchors WT-A-F1 through WT-A-F4.
WT-C carries four face anchors WT-C-F1 through WT-C-F4.
Current wing pole naming is WT-L1 through WT-L4 and WT-R1 through WT-R4.
WT-E is a physical FreeCAD-referenced pole/node whose exact identity/equivalence and coordinates remain extraction-gated.
Mirrored architecture is a QA/design constraint but must not be used to fabricate missing coordinates.
The legacy Type1 FreeCAD 60 m height, 18 m envelope and +250 m X relation are placeholder provenance only.

material_routing_guardrail.owner_rule: solid structural thickness >=120 mm routes to reinforced-concrete family; below 120 mm routes to steel-frame family
material_routing_guardrail.warning: This rule classifies material families; it does not size or certify any structural member.

publication_boundary: No site, approval, partner, structural compliance, blast, ballistic, fire, Solar Hull performance or operational claim is authorised by this schema.
Security-sensitive geometry and implementation details require a separate controlled classification before any web/API export.
The locked sunset Watch Tower render is an aesthetic reference only and must never override attributable CAD/source geometry.
